initialState: Each actor starts a fresh browser on the same explicitly blocked primary page. No spontaneous discovery of a dead end is claimed.
limitations: Both actors use Jev; new categorical action-relation questions are the declared intervention. Questions differ intentionally; initial product, goal, assessment input and attached images must match.
The model supplies fallible categorical hypotheses, not verified UI semantics. An evidence reference does not establish that the hypothesis is correct.
Later trajectories and model inputs can differ; two repeats per cell do not establish general stability or human fidelity.
Charged reservations do not prove HTTP attempts or service receipt. API time and human time remain separate.
Mock results verify integration only and are never real-model performance evidence.

independentAudit.scope: API wiring, source/frame/selection/operation/accounting provenance and descriptive outcomes; not proof of hypothesis meaning or human fidelity
